notes.title: 16.09.25 (Build 708) Update
notes.content:
[h2]Update[/h2][list][*][p]Character-specific traits have been added.
Each character specializes in different areas such as survival, attack, defense, and supply.
These values and information can be viewed in the character selection screen.[/p][/*][*][p]The lobby now displays the character selection screen upon first entry.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where weapons like the VoltEdge Saw and Boom Box would emit operational sounds even when out of ammo.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies now rarely drop small ammo packs.
Small ammo packs replenish 20% of the current weapon's ammo and 10% of other weapons' ammo.[/p][/*][*][p]The ammo capacity of most Legendary weapons has been increased by approximately 10%.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 10.09.25 (Build 690) Update
notes.content: [h2]Update[/h2][list][*][p]Accuracy improvement during ADS now functions correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the player's hands would appear empty when discarding a weapon mid-switch.[/p][/*][*][p]Weapons equipped on DOGGIE will now display in teammates' status windows.[/p][/*][*][p]Coin colors have been changed for improved visibility.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now sell weapons you currently possess at the store.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Content in Development[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44975477/04466109d261fd4cb6b4e1f0471dccb3b9b6d9fc.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Currently, patches are mainly focused on bug fixes and system improvements, so I felt it necessary to share the current WIP contents.[/p][/*][*][p]The mode currently in development is “Sole Survivor” mode. This mode involves defeating endless waves of enemies, gaining experience to grow stronger, and surviving for a limited time.[/p][/*][*][p]The core systems are all ready, but we're currently finding the right balance: if there are even slightly more enemies, the difficulty becomes too high, and if there are fewer, it doesn't feel like waves.[/p][/*][*][p]If you have any questions or ideas about this mode, please let us know anytime![/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 04.09.25 (Build 677) Update
notes.content: [h2]Update[/h2][list][*][p]Enemy attack power has been slightly reduced on Normal difficulty.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where shotgun weapons fired in the wrong direction when using the “Multi-Trigger Interface” artifact.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where hit detection would not occur properly when the projectile speed of the “Warglaive Caster” and “Disperser” was too fast.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where an error would occur in the options window when a controller was not connected.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare issue where an error could occur in the game mode selection window.[/p][/*][*][p]Power-up icons have been changed. The previous icons will be used for a new item called the Enhancement Device.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Known Issues[/h2][list][*][p]If the game is launched with the controller inactive, the controller may not be recognized until the game is turned off and back on.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 01.09.25 (Build 675) Update
notes.content: [h2]Update[/h2][list][*][p][b]Joypad support is now available.[/b][/p][p]This is currently close to a beta version and may require further fine-tuning and feature additions.[/p][p]All types of feedback are welcome![/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Joypad-related settings have been added to the Options menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Shortcut key images in the tutorial and UI have been updated.[/p][/*][*][p]Running has been removed from all modes. The tutorial now also uses dashing.[/p][/*][*][p]Pilot Special's firing sounds have been reduced in volume.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Known Issues[/h2][list][*][p]If you launch the game with the controller inactive, the controller may not be recognized until you restart the game.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 22.08.25 (Build 637) Update
notes.content: [h2]Update[/h2][list][*][p]A demo version build has been added, and a demo store page has been created.[/p][/*][*][p]A Level 4 weapon boombox has been added.[/p][/*][*][p]A Level 4 weapon disperser has been added.[/p][/*][*][p]A Level 5 weapon super shotgun has been added.[/p][/*][*][p]Guided weapons no longer have guided chipsets attached to them.[/p][/*][*][p]The price of artifacts has increased by 20%.[/p][/*][*][p]The values of some artifacts that increase shields have been reduced.[/p][/*][*][p]All active items that could only be used once have been changed to be reusable.[/p][/*][*][p]The ammunition recovery amount of the ammunition box active has been reduced from 100% to 50%.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]The issue where the drop location of items occasionally differed between the server and client has been fixed.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 08.08.25 (Build 631) Update
notes.content: [h2]Update[/h2][list][*][p]You can now remotely install weapons on D.O.G.G.I.E. by holding down F while looking at a dropped weapon.[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced all weapon shaders with lighter ones.[/p][/*][*][p]Help popups have been added for specific situations. These popups appear when needed but are not displayed during multiplayer. The added help popups are as follows:[/p][list][*][p]Help message about protecting D.O.G.G.I.E.[/p][/*][*][p]Help message about equipping D.O.G.G.I.E. weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Dash help message[/p][/*][*][p]Help message about the ? button[/p][/*][*][p]Help message about support drones[/p][/*][*][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]Bug fixes[/h2][list][*][p]An issue where a player who died in multiplayer under specific circumstances would respawn unexpectedly has been fixed.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 08.05.25 (Build 619) Updated
notes.content: [h2]Update[/h2][list][*][p]Add a respawn pod to the test cell.[/p][/*][*][p]Now the respawn pod's presence is indicated in the path selection window.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the enemy attack damage range indicator shader so it's more visible in bright areas.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies now have reduced health and slightly increased attack power on Hard difficulty.[/p][/*][*][p]Techno Tusk's laser traps now have significantly reduced health.[/p][/*][*][p]Techno Tusk's HP has been reduced.[/p][/*][*][p]Patterns added in Hard difficulty have been adjusted to be more threatening and used more frequently.[/p][/*][*][p]All windows now close when starting the game in Squad mode.[/p][/*][*][p]The current health and maximum health of allies are now displayed in the tab window.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Some missing translations have been added.[/p][/*][*][p]An issue where the remaining duration of buffs was not updated during multiplayer has been fixed.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 08.01.25 (Build 604) Updated
notes.content: [h2]Update[/h2][list][*][p]The brand image and trailer video have been changed.[/p][/*][*][p]Now, when the squad presses “Ready,” a sound will be played by the host.[/p][/*][*][p]The color of the damage text has been changed.[/p][/*][*][p]The firing effect of the cannon summoned by Lady Embertail has been changed.[/p][/*][*][p]The height of Techno Tusk's platform has been lowered by 2 meters.[/p][/*][*][p]The rewards received after each room's battle have been changed to be provided only to players currently alive.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]The issue where the laser traps summoned by Techno Tusk were not properly synchronized in multiplayer has been resolved.[/p][/*][*][p]The issue where the second-floor map did not progress under specific conditions has been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]The issue where bullets penetrated physics and fell in low-frame environments has been fixed.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Furball Blitz! Early Access Begins!
notes.content: [h2]Hello![/h2][p]The early access for Furball Blitz! has finally begun.[/p][p]This game is a casual shooting game based on a shoulder-view TPS, aiming to deliver intense gunfights with a variety of weapons and relics.[/p][p][/p][p]The current early access version includes a dungeon crawl roguelike mode called “Escort Mode.”[/p][p][/p][h2]Planned updates until official release[/h2][list][*][p]Wave-based defense mode[/p][/*][*][p]PvP modes such as Deathmatch and Team Deathmatch[/p][/*][*][p]Addition of more weapons and relics[/p][/*][/list][p]and more are planned.[/p][p][/p][h2]We need your help[/h2][p]Furball Blitz! will actively incorporate user feedback through Early Access to continue improving the game.[/p][list][*][p]Which weapons were fun to use, and which ones would you like to see added?[/p][/*][*][p]Is the balance of each growth structure well-balanced?[/p][/*][*][p]Or, any opinions or ideas on improvements to the game, or features you'd like to see added (even modes!)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]All feedback is appreciated.[/p][p]Any form of feedback is welcome![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you.[/p]
